title: Q-PARITY-2: Post-deploy probes with automatic revert (QNFO DEPLOY-PROBES-1 / canary_revert)
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** grep:.github/workflows/deploy-system.yml::revert
**Status:** open

Quniverse parity (owner directive 2026-11-13: Ultrastable audits and remediates all failure modes and ships improvements with zero user intervention; every Quniverse automation feature is incorporated).

QNFO declares per-worker probes.json (routes with a real marker, /health VERSION poll), baselines them before deploy and reverts the push when a probe that passed before fails after. Ultrastable's deploy-system.yml proves a deploy only by a health call. Add platform/probes + a revert step to deploy-system.yml, reusing deploy/ scripts, with a test that a failing-after probe reverts.

size: M

**Closing probe:** grep:.github/workflows/deploy-system.yml::revert
